summary: The default Enhancement build, with Improved Ghost Wolf for utility.
rotation: Pre-pull: Strength of Earth IV at -6s, Windfury Totem at -5s, Mana Spring at -4s, Lightning Shield at -3s, Magma Totem at -1.5s. The totems last the fight, except the last few seconds of a 300s one.
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Magma Totem when it is down, with at least 2s left
Rage of the Farseer with the on-use trinket, and Blood Fury with them
Other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion)
Stormstrike once Windfury Weapon's 1.5s cooldown is back, so its main-hand strike can proc the weapon (and Windfury Totem); the lines below go meanwhile
Fire Nova while Clearcasting is up
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova while mana is above 16 per second of fight left
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready. Its orbs fire at the boss when the shaman takes a hit, about 2 a minute.
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Maelstrom Weapon procs 6 to 10 times a minute by rank (10 at 5/5, scaled by the main hand's speed) and takes 20% off a spell's cast time and mana per stack, Blizzard's 2026-11-10 hotfix post. No server row carries it yet.
Open: whether Stormstrike can trigger Elemental Focus. If it can, Enhancement gets more Clearcasting procs than shown.
Assumed: the shaman takes 2 damage hits a minute. Each one fires Lightning Shield.

Fire Nova uses client build 70425's values: 0.143 coefficient, rank 5 base damage 232 to 259. Stormstrike (100% weapon damage, 8s) and Mental Dexterity (100% of Intellect as attack power at 3/3) take Blizzard's 2026-11-10 hotfix values; Flurry and the shocks the November 2 notes'. No server row carries them yet.
No Flametongue Totem: it and Windfury Totem replace each other on the beta (2026-11-08), and the group needs Windfury Totem.

Improved Ghost Wolf moved to row 4 in the November 2 notes, so its two points now need 15 Enhancement points above them. They come out of Ancestral Knowledge and Maelstrom Weapon, and Tidal Focus 3 brings melee hit to the 8% cap.
The relic is Burning Totem. Totem of the Storm ties it within 2 DPS at every fight length.

Windfury Weapon and the shaman's own Windfury Totem both proc since the 2026-11-10 hotfixes (each with its own chance and cooldown, an assumption), and our combat logs show Windfury Weapon's extra attacks can roll Windfury Totem, so the two chain. Windfury Weapon with Windfury Totem and Magma Totem beats Flametongue Weapon by 129 DPS at 180s (Rockbiter about as much, Frostbrand by more), and Flametongue Totem in Windfury Totem's place by 140.
Wears The Five Thunders 6-piece (Phase 0 list). The 4-piece proc rate (The Furious Storm) is unconfirmed, and the 5-piece's disarm isn't simmed.
